decisions.reason: Its early adoption and very strong fit with the firm's core network and data-centre capabilities put performance at or above aspiration, so a large expanding firm would usually retain it despite limited later visibility.

Optical spectrum connectivity matches the firm's owned fibre assets and strategic push toward high-bandwidth software-defined infrastructure, so organizational slack supports continued offering while results remain somewhat uncertain.

Although voice-related demand is less attractive and later evidence is thin, the portal is a low-resource complement that improves automation in the existing voice business and therefore is still worth keeping for now.

With no visible later traction and with enterprise telecom shifting away from stand-alone voice services, this product is more likely to fall below aspiration and have its resources redirected to stronger infrastructure and new development areas.
